scope: Training-only all-13 reviewed-pixel diagnostic; no independent accuracy or temporal inference.

dataset_audit.feature_handling: Exported finite values unchanged; non-finite ignored inputs replaced with zero only

objective.name: dataset_reviewed_pixel_mean_weighted_bce
objective.normalization: Mean is over reviewed pixel count, not class-weight mass. Report mean-weight-normalized BCE separately.
objective.fixed_parameter_identity: Mean of all scaled image losses/gradients equals full reviewed-pixel loss/gradient. Sequential updates are not one full-batch update.

protocol.feature_normalization: preserve exported arrays; no new transform

limitations: This run uses all 13 reviewed training groups; no held-out selection or generalization claim.
Ignored pixels are unknown, never negatives.
Longer exposure and changed normalization differ from the old 26-step smoke; there is no isolated empirical causal comparison.
All checkpoints and the final no-fit outcome are retained; no threshold tuning, early stopping or rerun-until-pass.
Model selection requires geographically separate reviewed validation.
Annotation image dates are not exact felling dates; temporal inference remains later work.
